verdict.rationale: Inngest ships an official CLI documented at /docs/cli that lets users inspect runs, fetch traces, invoke functions, and even give coding agents access to Inngest data from the terminal, plus a dedicated guide on debugging failed runs entirely from the CLI — directly serving AI-native/agentic workflows. missing for 10: independent hands-on community confirmation of the CLI specifically (community quotes reference dev server/DX generally, not the CLI by name).
